loader.exitGeometry: clip-path polygon two-band CENTER-OUT SPLIT on .loading-main: a horizontal slit opens at the vertical centre (band 49.94–50.06% at t=6366) and widens symmetrically to 0%/100% at t=7201 (38.38/59.30 @6480 → 28.63/67.11 @6600 → 14.01/78.82 @6841 → 0/100 @7201); counter hits 100% at 5649, ~717ms hold, then exit; element survives as .loading.loaded with inner opacity 0
loader.gating: none on full loads — REPLAYS on same-tab reload (measured: reloadGate 15% @258ms → 100% @4680ms); NOT replayed on Barba subpage transitions (loaderDisplay 'none' throughout route.json); sessionStorage 'isLoaded' flag exists in the loader class code (heronai-bp main.js) but does not suppress the reload replay

routeTransition.geometry: Barba sync swap (path/URL changes at click+~142ms); .main gets clip-path: inset(var(--mask-percent)) !important — a 4-EDGE INSET WIPE: --trans-percent runs 0→50% by 897ms (r308: power1.in), the four .main-deco frame lines converge to the centre, --size--line spikes to 1 (≈8.33px) exactly at the 50% midpoint then decays 1→0; then --mask-percent opens 50%→0% by ~1616ms (r308: power1.out) revealing the new page; no fade, no loader replay

scroll.engine: lenis 1.1.5 (unpkg) + GSAP 3.12.5 ticker + ScrollTrigger 3.12.5 (ScrollTrigger.update on every lenis scroll)

params.wrapper: .main-inner (fallback document.querySelector; barba next container on transitions)
params.lerp: 0.1 (constructor default — no override found in heronai-bp.netlify.app/main.js 'new Lenis({...})')
params.note: exact instantiation read from heronai-bp.netlify.app/main.js: new Lenis({wrapper, content, syncTouch:!0, smoothWheel:!0, smoothTouch:!1, infinite:!1}); idle class added after 150ms scroll-quiet via setTimeout

scroll.probeShape: exponential ease-out glide: 720px wheel target — first motion +156ms, 456px (63%) by 637ms, 710px (98.6%) by 1181ms, settled 720px at 1695ms, flat for 1.3s+ after (classic lerp damping, no fixed duration)
